name: Kloepper
description: Kloepper (literally 'Knocker' or 'Kloppen') is a high-energy German card game that blends rhythm, memory, and fast reaction times. Distinct from European trick-taking games, it is primarily a social shedding or 'slap' game where the objective is to hit the center pile when specific conditions are met (similar to 'Slapjack' or 'Taco Cat Goat Cheese Pizza'). It is often played as a fast-paced drinking or party game.

Distinct from European trick-taking games, it is primarily a social shedding or 'slap' game where the objective is to hit the center pile when specific conditions are met (similar to 'Slapjack' or 'Taco Cat Goat Cheese Pizza'). It is often played as a fast-paced drinking or party game.
Part of the 'Slapjack' family of games found across Europe. It gained a distinct identity in German student circles and rural social gatherings ('Kneipen') during the 20th century.
Usually a 32-card German deck (7 to Ace) or a standard 52-card deck.
